description: Create a TypeScript or JavaScript file named 'mockDataGenerator.ts' or 'mockDataGenerator.js' that generates realistic mock data for an e-commerce application. The file must include: (1) Functions to generate at least 3 entity types: Users (with name, email, address), Products (with name, SKU, price, category), and Orders (with userId, items array, subtotal, shipping, tax, total). (2) Maintain referential integrity where orders reference valid user IDs and order items reference valid product IDs. (3) Calculate order totals correctly by summing item prices, adding shipping and tax. (4) Organize code with multiple helper functions (at least 3-5 functions). (5) Include variety for edge cases like international addresses, various order sizes, and multiple product categories. (6) Use random data generation (Math.random or similar) to create varied but realistic data. The file should be well-structured with clear function separation and proper exports for reuse.
